instructions.scope: Offline academic project synthesis. Read only this execution's explicitly supplied saved results. Do not download, recalibrate, simulate, change allocations or overwrite source outputs.
instructions.returns: Use simple daily returns for the main historical summary; the detailed statistics report retains both simple and log returns. Historical daily statistics and forecast-horizon losses are different quantities.
instructions.comparison: Compare full portfolios when currency, holdings, weights, investment convention, calibration observations and intended forecast dates agree. Available physical local-volatility results participate in the main analysis while their saved validation status remains visible. Stress and tail sensitivities stay separate.
instructions.clock: The optional 0.5% relative horizon tolerance permits an explicitly approximate terminal comparison between exchange-session time and ACT/365F. It never makes daily path metrics or drawdowns directly comparable.
instructions.materiality: A two-percentage-point difference in loss probability is a descriptive review threshold, not a hypothesis test or evidence that one model is correct.
instructions.uncertainty: Mean intervals use the Monte Carlo standard error. Loss-probability intervals use Wilson intervals for independent simulated paths. Neither accounts for parameter estimation, missing data or model risk.
instructions.figures: Chart point limits affect display only. All saved terminal observations contribute to metrics. Surface figures show supported grid points, not an endorsement of extrapolated wings.
instructions.simulation_plots: Show saved portfolio paths with full-population bands, mean/median growth, empirical terminal density and logarithmic tails. Sample paths are a deterministic display subset, never used to estimate bands or tail probabilities. No path pairing or common-grid return inference across engines.
